title: FINMA Circular 2024/2 — sustainability disclosure interpretation memo
content: This memo summarises CPI Compliance's working interpretation of the disclosure scope under the circular, intended for RM-side use only and not for redistribution. Scope: institutional clients with explicit ESG mandates, all foundation and pension segment clients regardless of mandate, and HNW/UHNW clients on request. Required artefacts: portfolio-level ESG composite report, exclusion-list compliance statement, and a narrative attestation. Phased deadlines: institutional templates 2026-09-30; HNW/UHNW on-request 2027-03-31. Operational note: the templates can be auto-generated from the standard CPI portfolio reports; manual narrative adjustment is required for clients with bespoke exclusion lists. Internal codename for this workstream: Project Edelweiss.
